entities.summary: David John Lowry is a Canadian ice hockey coach and former professional player. As of 2025 he is an assistant coach with the Calgary Flames of the National Hockey League (NHL). He played in the NHL from 1985 to 2004. Lowry's sons, Adam and Joel, were drafted by the Winnipeg Jets and the Los Angeles Kings, respectively.
